question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The people living in coastal areas were evacuated by time.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The segment **'by time' **contains a grammatical error.
 
• **'By time' **should be replaced by **'****in time'**.
 
• **In time: **eventually; early enough.
 
 
• **Example: **I want to be home **in time** for tea.
 
 
 
• The use of the preposition **'in'** is the most appropriate here because** 'in time'** means that people were evacuated early enough so as to avoid any loss of lives because of any disaster.
 
• Hence, the segment that contains a grammatical error is **'****by time'**.

 

**Correct sentence:** *The people living in coastal areas were evacuated** in time**.*
